breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly fixes the error. It no longer states that slope vanishes at the supports. Instead, it correctly identifies that zero slope occurs at midspan by symmetry ('Verify that the boundary condition of zero slope at midspan is satisfied by symmetry') and treats the support slope as a non-zero quantity to be calculated ('Calculate the slope at the supports using the appropriate beam deflection formula'). This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
